name: Contract sign
oneLiner: a printed contract on real paper is slid onto a walnut desk under a lamp, the camera travels down its clauses to the signature line where a sign-here tab peels away, the signer's name writes itself in blue ink on twos, the date follows, and a green SIGNED stamp slams over the block
say: when the speaker says the deal got signed or the paperwork went through ('they signed on Friday', 'we made it official'): cut in as they set it up, the name writes on 'signed' and the stamp lands on the beat after
